name: Opportunity Rover
about: Opportunity Rover (2003-032A, NASA/JPL), launched 2003 Jul  8. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Mars on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.991 au and aphelion 1.516 au against GCAT's 1.000 and 1.520
